headline: Paraguay Central Bank President Resigns Amid Ueno Bank Resolution Crisis
summary: Paraguay's Central Bank President Carlos Carvallo resigned amid a resolution process against digital financial institution Ueno Bank, which left clients seeking access to frozen funds.
why: Regulatory interventions in the digital banking sector highlight credit and liquidity risks within regional financial systems, affecting depositor confidence and central bank stability.

impacts.name: Paraguay
impacts.why: Central bank leadership departure and digital bank resolution proceedings create financial sector uncertainty.
